param.pythonReference: Single-band integer classified raster. Class values are the strata.

param.pythonReference: Point feature class of sample locations (pixel centres).

param.pythonReference: Target standard error of overall accuracy, S(O). 0.01 is a common choice; smaller values need many more points.

tool.summary: Designs a stratified random reference sample for a classified raster: total sample size from a target standard error of overall accuracy (Olofsson et al. 2014, eq. 13), allocation to classes in proportion to mapped area with a minimum per class, and seeded random points at pixel centres.
tool.usage:
The raster must be a single-band integer raster in a projected (ideally equal-area) coordinate system.

Each class is a stratum; points are a simple random sample of pixels within each class.

Output points carry MAP_CLASS (the stratum), STRAT_W (mapped area proportion) and an empty REF_CLASS field for the reference label.

The same seed and inputs always produce the same points.
